description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR A. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.12; no self-approval.

Deliver one independently usable/reviewable outcome PR: correct durable history and access. Include trusted provider facts and per-message email recipient evidence; Direct/Shared/Replicated transcript creation/persistence; passive capture before response triggers; authorized reads and membership reconciliation/revocation; communication-channel access controls; safe legacy migration/fresh-history cutover. Acceptance: nonmention retained without response; threads inherit channel permissions; provider revocation removes provider-derived access but preserves independent manual grant; new email recipients cannot read earlier messages; existing history/ratings/attachments/traces survive. Exclude hidden Bcc wherever independent evidence is unavailable. Define/test a supported provider matrix; optional provider enhancements must not block a correctly bounded first release. No dependency on PR B live execution. Detailed beads and cohesive internal commits are tracking units, NOT separate PRs. Consolidate owning draft foundations where practical. Include A-specific documentation, validation, explicit human UX approval before new E2E, coverage/review and final gate. Do not infer feature completion from closed foundation beads.
title: [zaq-emb.27] PR A — Strategy-driven, authorized channel history
